criteria.name: L01
criteria.description: 候选的来源说明虚构了随包材料中不存在的文件、页码或表格。只评来源定位是否真实；数值错算、选错重述口径及已由程序判据计分的额外记录不在此项扣分。未提供来源在程序来源项失分，本项不重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: Source cells in Powercor_RFM_inputs.xlsx (F61/F62/F64/F115-F118/F169-F172/L7-L13 etc.) all exist with values matching candidate descriptions. Distribution_handbook.pdf contains s2.3.5 and s2.2 references. No fabricated files/pages/tables found.

criteria.name: L02
criteria.description: 候选声称已经完成外部审计、实时查询或独立核验，但随包输入及候选证据没有支持该完成性陈述。正常分析措辞和未作此类声称不扣分。
criteria.reasoning: No claims of completed external audits, real-time queries, or independent verification. All statements are analytical descriptions based on provided input files.

criteria.name: L03
criteria.description: 候选在说明性文字中编造无法从随包输入获得的公司经营事实。只评新增事实性断言，排除数值计算错误、来源定位和额外业务记录，以免与其他判据重复扣分。
criteria.reasoning: All numerical values traceable to input file cells. No fabricated company operational facts beyond what can be derived from the provided inputs.
